stance_rationale: D_ENSEMBLE fails its own DSR gate and the hard turnover mandate, while the selected ensemble is weaker than the best single model on ICIR and DSR. The package also depends on unresolved PIT-C13/C14/C15 carve-outs and lacks D_ENSEMBLE-specific Charter §8 lineage.

icir.qualification: Passes threshold but is below LightGBM single-model ICIR=0.4467376024276969.

harvey_t.qualification: Single IC HAC t-stat only; 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 robustness is absent.

sub_stability.qualification: First subperiod has only 9 sig_dates, so stability=1.0 is fragile.

RF-A2.evidence: Selected ensemble ICIR=0.4124 is below LightGBM ICIR=0.4467; ensemble DSR=0.1574 is also below LightGBM DSR=0.1878.

RF-A4.evidence: Sector dummies are not a post-hoc sector-neutral IC retention test; retention after neutralization is unreported.

RF-A5.evidence: No top-decile row below 1e8 TV found; however the 2e8 hard floor has 1 top-decile t-1 breach and the package liquidity audit is marked pending.

RF-A6.evidence: DSR=0.1574 < 0.50, 5-spec reporting absent, and selection_objective='icir' conflicts with code selecting highest mean IC.

RF-A7.evidence: D_ENSEMBLE alpha_scores has 116 monthly sig_dates and weights_schedule also has 116 dates.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: D_ENSEMBLE alpha_scores.parquet is Date x Ticker x score shaped. The user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts alpha_scores path is an older 83-date artifact, not the D_ENSEMBLE signal_matrix_ref.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: D_ML feature build uses raw *_zxs and int_quality_lowbeta = Q08_Composite_Quality_zxs * (-D02_Beta_zxs), not Z_Score_Aligned-only.
No Usable_Date <= sig_date audit is provided for daily factor or fundamental inputs; package labels this as N/A.
Daily factor DB is loaded through direct read_parquet from .cache/factor_db_daily, while the required base context mandates load_month_factors().
Monthly snapshots map sig_date to prior trading day; no same-day DD/regime overlay was found.
V01_BM, V02_EP, Q02_ROE/Q03_ROA-like fundamental features are used without an annual-May or quarterly-45d lag proof.

critical_concerns.description: The package self-fails the graduation DSR gate: DSR=0.1574 < 0.50 before expanding n_trials beyond 93 for feature-block choices, model families, Optuna sweeps, and method selection.

The ensemble premium claim is the weakest statistical claim: best ensemble mean IC exceeds LightGBM by only +0.00047, while selected ensemble ICIR=0.4124 and DSR=0.1574 are worse than LightGBM ICIR=0.4467 and DSR=0.1878.
AX-007 ML sizing exception is not earned: multi_sleeve=false, the emitted weights_schedule is equal-weight 5% per name, and confidence_vector is not used for sizing.
Turnover hard cap fails: D_ENSEMBLE annualized two-way turnover is 15.14x versus the 6.0x mandate, implying about 227 bps/year one-way 15 bps trading drag before market impact.

PIT carve-out is asserted rather than proven: direct daily parquet loading, manual -D02_Beta_zxs, missing Usable_Date lineage, and missing fundamental lag audit conflict with required PIT-C13/C14/C15/C4 checks.
Required robustness is incomplete: no post-neutral sector IC retention, no CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 5-spec matrix, no cost-aware net result, and no MDD/drawdown-days hurdle result.

Liquidity governance is not package-grade: latest/top20 weights pass t-1 2e8 liquidity with 0 breaches, but the package's top20_liquidity_audit.csv says audit pending and top-decile t-1 hard-floor audit found 1 breach at 189.7m KRW.
Charter §8 is incomplete for D_ENSEMBLE: codex_critic_response_alpha_D_ENSEMBLE.json, challenge_note_D_ENSEMBLE.md, alpha_package_D_ENSEMBLE.json, and D_ENSEMBLE lineage entries are absent.
AX-001 v2 pass is overstated: bad/normal IC ratio uses a soft bottom-quartile market proxy, not the required crisis_alpha plus Core-relative MDD mitigation plus bad/normal IC ratio package.

Requested downstream artifacts do not validate the package: weights.csv and qepm/stage_artifacts covariance.parquet are missing; the alternate risk_D covariance is PSD but condition number is 291.8 > 100.

supporting_arguments: D_ENSEMBLE alpha_scores is genuinely time-series shaped: 40276 rows, 116 monthly sig_dates, 2014-04-30 to 2023-11-30.
Basic alpha thresholds pass before DSR and robustness penalties: rank_ic=0.0508, ICIR=0.4124, HAC t=4.4260, monotonicity=0.9636.
The D_ENSEMBLE weights_schedule satisfies max_names=20, long-only, 0 <= w <= 0.20, and sum(w)=1 per date.
unresolved_disputes: Whether any binding ML daily-parquet carve-out can override PIT-C15; the required base context does not grant one.
Whether IC-weighted ensemble selection is legitimate when the declared selection_objective is icir and LightGBM has higher ICIR/DSR.
Whether daily factor DB fundamentals already satisfy C4 reporting lags and C14 Usable_Date constraints; no proof is attached.
Whether the proper DSR denominator should be 93 or include the full feature/model/hypothesis search space.
Whether D_REFINE or risk_D artifacts supersede D_ENSEMBLE, since they are not integrated into the target package lineage.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that a +0.00047 mean-IC ensemble premium is enough to justify D_ENSEMBLE despite lower ICIR/DSR than LightGBM, DSR failure, turnover failure, and unresolved PIT carve-outs.
rebuttal_required: Pre-register and correct the selection objective: if objective is ICIR, explain why LightGBM was not selected; if objective is mean IC, update the package and DSR denominator.
Recompute DSR using a full effective trial count covering feature selection, Optuna trials, model families, ensemble methods, and parallel hypotheses.
Provide PIT-C13/C14/C15 evidence: Z_Score_Aligned provenance or binding carve-out, Usable_Date <= sig_date audit, and fundamental lag audit.
Emit a true ML-sized weights schedule or remove AX-007 exception #4; verify turnover < 600% and 15 bps cost-net performance.
Run sector-neutral retention, 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6, cost-net SR, MDD, and drawdown-days tests.
Create D_ENSEMBLE-specific codex response, challenge_note, final package, and lineage, or explicitly mark this draft as rejected.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The target is not merely deployment-ineligible; its ensemble selection claim is weaker than the single-model baseline on the declared ICIR objective.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the selected ensemble beat LightGBM on the pre-declared objective after DSR correction?
Can alpha vector generation be made PIT-compliant without direct daily parquet and manual sign handling?
Can the signal survive 5-spec and sector-neutral retention while keeping turnover below 600% at 15 bps one-way cost?
